channel.title: SimLens
channel.description: Updates for SimLens, a camera for the iOS Simulator.

item.title: SimLens 1.4.1
item.description:
Changed

  • Check for Updates… says plainly what it found: "SimLens is up to date — you have the latest version, 1.4.0", "A new version of SimLens is available — SimLens 1.5.0 is available. You have 1.4.0" (with Install Update… and Later), or "Couldn't check for updates" with the reason (for example, no internet connection) and Try Again. Settings › Updates and About show the result of the last check, with Install Update when a new version is waiting.

    • Fixed

  • Quitting SimLens with kill / pkill while one of its alerts was open did nothing until the alert was closed.

item.title: SimLens 1.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • SimLens Pro: a 14-day trial with every feature, then a $15 one-time licence (1 year of updates) bought through Paddle. A Licence window with Buy and key entry; Activate in SimLens links (simlens://activate) from the purchase page; keys are checked offline. simlensctl and headless mode need a licence after the trial too.
  • Automatic updates (Sparkle 2): SimLens checks the public SimLens-releases feed once a day (Settings › Updates, or About › Check for Updates…). Updates are EdDSA-signed and verified before installing. Downloads move to the public [SimLens-releases](https://github.com/ErIMRANALAM/SimLens-releases) repository.
  • SimLensTestKit: a Swift package for UI tests — SimLens.show(.barcode(…) / .image(…) / .sample(.receipt) …, on: .front) from inside an XCUITest, plus SimLens.launchEnvironment for the app under test. Requests travel as files, since the simulator can't reach the control port.
  • Sample images: a made-up receipt, document, specimen ID card, business card, product barcode, QR poster and boarding pass, in the Image source's new Samples menu and in SimLensTestKit.
  • CI / headless mode: simlensctl start --headless [--source …] runs SimLens without any UI for build servers; simlensctl wait blocks until a simulator has the camera; simlensctl stop [--quit]; simlensctl status --json. Example GitHub Actions workflow in docs/ci/github-actions.yml.
  • Video recording and microphone: AVCaptureMovieFileOutput records real H.264/HEVC movies of the stream with AAC sound and the usual delegate callbacks. A virtual microphone gives sessions sound from the Mac's microphone (when the app has microphone permission; silence otherwise), also for AVCaptureAudioDataOutput.
  • Camera controls and lenses: zoom (crops towards the centre, with ramps), torch, exposure bias, and focus, exposure and white-balance modes and points of interest now work. Apps find back ultra-wide and telephoto (3×) cameras and Dual, Dual Wide and Triple devices with real switch-over zoom factors. Photos and code scanning see the zoom too.
  • Barcodes: the QR Code source is now Barcode and also generates Aztec, PDF417, Code 128, EAN-13 and EAN-8 (EAN check digits added). Apps now read every code type the camera supports (Data Matrix, EAN, UPC-E, Code 39/93/128, ITF, Codabar, GS1 DataBar, Micro QR/PDF417 …) with the right type, not just QR. simlensctl generate-barcode <value> --type ean13.
  • Separate front and back cameras: the menu's Back | Front switch gives the front camera its own source (e.g. Passthrough on the back, the webcam on the front). simlensctl set-source <source> --position front, and set-source same --position front to follow the back camera again. Photos come from the camera in use.

    • Changed

  • Redesigned About window: publisher and developer cards with icons, links you can right-click to copy, and a Support button.

    • Fixed

  • A rare crash when switching sources quickly.
  • The virtual camera now reports that it does not support multi-camera capture (isMultiCamSupported).
  • Opening a second copy of SimLens no longer removes the running copy's Xcode setup or simulator camera; it brings the running copy forward instead.
